name: TC-1968: removing the picture right after the create-time AI job was queued keeps it removed
description: Create a deal (queues one AI picture job), upload a picture immediately with no settle wait, then DELETE it. For the next 60 s (20 reads, 3 s apart) the list row's picture stays { url: null, status: null }: the owner's action wins, the AI job never brings a picture back.
